entry_state: Drawing conditions the commitment distribution while preserving its credit baseline. The funded non-POCI path retains negative equity and distinguishes impairment from discount unwind and write-off. A POCI purchase now prices initial expected losses into the credit-adjusted rate.
exit_state: POCI recognises subsequent loss changes from its purchase baseline. A favourable change permits a negative signed allowance; its unwind is interest, not another credit gain. Financial derecognition leaves legal discharge unassessed.
findings: Initial expected loss 50 is embedded in the price and rate, so the additional acquisition allowance is zero.
A year-one collection forecast of 88 gives net 80 and allowance negative 25; a zero floor would suppress the required gain.

Net interest 8 equals gross accretion 5.5 less signed-allowance unwind negative 2.5. Final receipt 70 gives total profit 20 and does not discharge the contractual shortfall 51. No new defect observed.
